| # Migration of ASW from RC30 to RC40 {#migration-of-asw-from-rc30-to-rc40-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

Portation CODESYS project from BODAS-design (CODESYS V2.3) to CODESYS V3.5:

See please CODESYS help: CODESYS Development System \> Creating and Configuring Projects \> Opening a V2.3 Project

 

The following information supports the migration of an application software which was written for RC30 to RC40.\
For that purpose the mapping of the BSW functions is shown if possible.

 

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Libary Basic                      | Explanation                                                                | |
| +===================================+============================================================================+ |
| | Basic - IN                        | Input functions for reading external signals                               | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - OUT                       | Output functions for setting output signals                                | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - SYS                       | System functions for defining general system behavior and error management | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - CAN                       | Configuration and access functions for CAN communication                   | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - EEP                       | Access functions for non-volatile data handling                            | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - EMCY                      | Stop function description\                                                 | |
| |                                   | This feature is not available in series 40.                                | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - MO                        | Hardware monitor description                                               | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - SAFOUT                    | Safety output description                                                  | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Basic - SENT                      | SENT input description                                                     | |
| +-----------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | Libraries (optional)              | Explanation                                                       | |
| +===================================+===================================================================+ |
| | DIAG                              | Please see UDS for tool BODAS-service                             | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | J1939                             | J1939 is included in the library ISOBUS.                          | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | CANopen                           | Planned for a later BSW version.                                  | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | UDS                               | 1\) For tool BODAS-service:                                       | |
| |                                   |                                                                   | |
| |                                   | 2\) For customer specific diagnostic tool.                        | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | ACOM                              | This feature is not available in series 40 (no hardware support). | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | CCP                               | CCP is included in the library XCP.                               | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | ISOBUS                            | ISOBUS communication according to ISO11783                        | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | LIN                               | Configuration and access functions for LIN communication          | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | INEXT                             | Not planned for series 40.                                        | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | OUTEXT                            | Not planned for series 40.                                        | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | RCE                               | Not planned for series 40.                                        | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
| | STM                               | Actuator STM interface\                                           | |
| |                                   | This interface is not supported by series 40.                     | |
| +-----------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------+ |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
